product.title: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park Experience Departing from Oahu

description.text: This volcano day leaves Honolulu on a flight to Kona International Airport, where a driver meets the group. More than eight hours on the ground include historic Kona, the Kilauea Iki Overlook, black sand, and Hawaii Volcanoes National Park. Ground transport is included with the inter-island flight. The park is an active volcanic landscape that is still forming the Big Island. Black sand and the Kilauea Iki Overlook share that ground day with historic Kona. The driver meets the group in Kona after the flight from Honolulu.
